Use case: style-transfer. This is the ONE final targeted revision of image 1, a generated medieval RPG head portrait, for a 74x100 low-resolution dialogue portrait. Redraw meaningfully, not a resize. Input 1 is the edit target; input 2 is identity reference only; images 3–6 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore coarse-cluster style references only, never copy their faces. Retain subject identity, three-quarter direction, hairstyle, ear, head outline and specified clothing. Critical shared fixes: replace bright white eye patches with TINY deep-set dark eyes, narrow lids, and only a subdued brown-gray sclera sliver roughly one pixel wide at target size. No white or ivory in eyes, no catchlights, no mascara. Reduce both eye heights; the warm skin planes must be much lighter than the eyes. Use three or four broad flat skin planes; no tiny decorative freckle/noise patches. Broad readable nose bridge/side and cheekbone structure. Merge fine parallel hair stripes into 4–6 irregular broad interlocking dark/brown masses with a few stepped highlights; no evenly spaced comb stripes. Merge collar's fine textile texture into two or three large flat planes. Hard coarse pixel-cluster silhouette, not smooth painterly illustration, not a posterized photoreal portrait; no dither, blur, gradients, thin line hatching or surface noise. Transparent background. At most 32 flat muted earthy colors. Large head, SHORT neck and NARROW collar: head fills most of height, collar only bottom 6–8 target pixels. Entire hair, bun/braid and ear are fully visible, with REAL transparent margin in the GENERATED source: portrait silhouette width no more than 88% canvas, at least 4 target-pixel-equivalent transparent margin left and right, at least 4 top and 3 bottom. Never crop then add padding; all hair genuinely drawn before the edge. No chest, torso, hands, props, symbols, labels or frame.

GURA, WOMAN IN HER MID-TO-LATE THIRTIES: current v1 reads angry because of pointed V eyebrows and two vertical forehead furrows. Remove both central forehead furrow strokes completely and relax the inner eyebrow ends so her thick brows are mostly level, one subtly questioning; no V-shaped scowl. Expression is calm practical attentiveness while checking a work segment, firm but unforced closed mouth with natural small corners. Preserve strong broad adult female face, short firm nose, warm ochre skin, deep brown side-part hair pulled into her low compact bun behind the visible ear, gaze toward viewer right. Eyes must become smaller, darker and less round as specified above. Do not make a teenager, glamorous model, nun or warrior. Preserve worn thick neutral-gray work coat as a very narrow collar, with a tiny dark-brown shoulder-strap edge. Merge these into large plain fabric planes, no crosshatching. Entire bun and ear must fit comfortably.
